definitions.applied: clamped [steer, throttle, brake] handed to hmmwv.Synchronize at each substep of interval k (frame >= 0)
definitions.range: max - min over the substeps of one interval, per channel
definitions.mean_minus_recorded: mean over substeps minus recorded action[k]
definitions.flip_within_interval: throttle > 0 at some substep and brake > 0 at another substep of the same interval
definitions.mode_switch_after_sub0: the exclusive throttle/brake mode of action[k] is left at some later substep of interval k
definitions.stalled: gb_build_cache.stalled_mask on the audited run (|vx|<0.3 & throttle>0.3, runs >= 20 frames)
definitions.brake_onset: brake > 0 at k and <= 0 at k-1 (recorded); pre_brake_onset = the interval before
definitions.hold_ok: gb_build_cache.hold_ok_mask on the audited run's recorded actions; the hold_ok / not_hold_ok regimes, hold_ok_share and recorded_transition_flip_rate cover only the n_transitions intervals with a recorded successor (the last interval of each episode is excluded, as in the cache's retention)
definitions.mid_interval_brake_substep_share: among intervals with recorded brake <= 0 whose applied path brakes at some substep: the share of substeps with brake > 0
definitions.xy_diff_at_frame0_m: distance between the local drive's and the cluster recording's pose at frame 0 (after the 0.8 s settle)
